description: Inventory of pinned test fixture images. Keep these references aligned with compose.yaml and the fixture Dockerfiles. Local and GitHub Actions runs use the same Compose definition; moving tags are not used.

activemq.rationale: Officially maintained Apache image. It replaces the abandoned upstream fixture image whose only tag was last pushed 2023-01-10.

activemq-proxy.rationale: A plain TCP relay in front of ActiveMQ, so that a recovery case can hold one address across a real broker restart. Compose publishes an ephemeral loopback port per container start, so a restarted broker returns on a different port every time and no client could reconnect to the address it was given; the proxy is never restarted and the broker behind it really goes away. Official Docker library image, 3.4 is the current stable line and carries the lts tag, GPLv2 with the LGPL runtime exception, and the manifest list covers linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 so the same digest serves the CI runner and a developer machine. The digest is the manifest list, not one architecture. The tag names the concrete release rather than the 3.4 line, for the same reason.

artemis.rationale: Artemis is the required second ActiveMQ LocalIntegration broker for the parameterized 'artemis' provider variants. It is pinned and run-scoped so the required gate has a reproducible endpoint instead of the fixed port and shared credentials carried by the imported baseline.

azurite.rationale: Microsoft's current stable Azurite release provides the real Azure Table wire contract for local integration tests. The multi-architecture OCI index digest fixes the exact image bytes while retaining native amd64 and arm64 execution. A run-scoped custom account replaces the public development account, and the in-memory data directory prevents state or credentials from surviving a run.

eventhubs.rationale: Microsoft's official Event Hubs emulator provides the local AMQP and partition-processing contract without Azure credentials. The concrete 2.2.1 image and manifest digest bind the bytes; Microsoft currently publishes this image for linux/amd64, so arm64 developer machines run this bounded fixture under container emulation.

localstack.rationale: LocalStack 4.14.0 is the final token-free Community release and provides the local SQS, SNS, DynamoDB and S3 wire contracts without making a personal or CI license secret part of the test platform. Starting with 2026.03.0 the unified image refuses startup without account-bound activation; a mandatory cloud license would violate the local, offline-capable fixture boundary. The manifest-list digest fixes linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 bytes. The fixture is ephemeral and loopback-only; current real IAM, quotas and service-managed delayed deletion remain External evidence.

mssql.rationale: SQL Server for the Entity Framework and SQL transport specs. It replaces mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, which Microsoft retired on 2025-09-30 and which receives no security or bug fixes: a discontinued image is not a test substrate. This is the supported SQL Server 2025 line on Ubuntu. It publishes linux/amd64 only, so on an arm64 developer machine it runs under emulation and the full SQL Server proof belongs to the x64 runner; PostgreSQL stays the fast local dialect check. The tag is the concrete cumulative update rather than a moving 'latest' that happens to point at this digest today: the digest fixes the bytes, and the tag makes the human statement equally exact.

postgres.rationale: PostgreSQL for the Entity Framework specs. The imported baseline used postgres:14.7; 16 is the current supported line and the specs use no version specific behaviour.

rabbitmq.rationale: Official Docker library image. The management plugin is required because the test set up creates and cleans the 'test' virtual host over the HTTP API on port 15672.

servicebus.rationale: Microsoft's official Service Bus emulator 2.0.0 provides native Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus 7.20.1 data and administration APIs. The manifest-list digest binds both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 bytes. The fixture uses ephemeral loopback AMQP and management ports and the existing supported SQL Server dependency; unsupported real-Azure semantics remain External rather than being inferred from the emulator.

rabbitmq_delayed_message_exchange.rationale: Community plugin, not part of the official image. Fifteen call sites use UseDelayedMessageScheduler and six declare x-delayed exchange arguments, so the tests cannot run without it. Built against RabbitMQ server 4.2.0, matching the pinned base.

publication.rationale: No fixture image is pushed to a registry. Local and CI runs use the same Compose definition, which builds the ActiveMQ Classic and RabbitMQ fixtures from pinned base images.
